mapper.insert: INSERT INTO zzl_ai_message (message_id, scope, conversation_id, run_id, role, content, model, token_count, created_at) VALUES (#{messageId}, #{scope}, #{conversationId}, #{runId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{model}, #{tokenCount}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT message_id, scope, conversation_id, run_id, role, content, model, token_count, created_at FROM zzl_ai_message WHERE scope = #{scope} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT 500
